violations.text: A large plastic bin containing food was observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the dry storage area have a small accumulation of rodent droppings. Area to be thoroughly cleaned and monitored. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
The floor in the dry storage area has an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Chocolate chips and brownie mix were observed adulterated with rodent droppings. Product was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back storage area/walk-in area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings and adulterated product. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. Ice machine was almost empty and turned off. Ice machine to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
